title: Preserve immutable baseline content with attributable custody
statement: The MOD-001 responsibility shall preserve immutable baseline content with attributable custody within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Exact immutable engineering content custody can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Preserve immutable baseline content with attributable custody.

why.rationale: SR-020 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests exact immutable engineering content custody.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Exact immutable engineering content custody. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Retain exact manifest membership, bytes, original profile/rules, provenance and included material independently of mutable current definitions; no alias to mutable source content.
Validate supported member kinds, containment and integrity; external-only references never count as preserved content and missing required members prevent full confirmation.
Stage and durably seal complete content before issuing a custody receipt; conflicting baseline bindings reject and unsupported platform durability cannot report complete preservation.
Preserve sealed bundles through catalog failure and uncertain receipts; reconcile exact stored effects after interruption without fabricated rollback or blind overwrite.
Return original selected content and precise missing, corrupt, unsupported or inaccessible scope without substitution of current bytes or rules.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
